Describe the provenance of a candidate knowledge change

Source: R/provenance.R
graft_provenance.Rd

Provenance identifies the producer and optional upstream run that supplied a candidate change. The producer and idempotency key form the replay boundary when a reviewed plan is committed.

Usage

graft_provenance(
  producer,
  version = NULL,
  run_id = NULL,
  idempotency_key = NULL,
  metadata = list()
)

Arguments

producer

One non-empty producer name.

version

Optional producer version.

run_id

Optional producer-side run identifier.

idempotency_key

Optional key identifying a replay for this producer.

metadata

A named JSON-serializable metadata list.

Value

An immutable GraftProvenance S7 object.
